room_orientation.shape: rectangle, approx 14 ft east-west by 21 ft north-south, 8 ft ceiling
room_orientation.west_wall: long wall with the fireplace centered on it; one single window to the left (south) of the fireplace and one connected pair of double-hung windows (a double window) to the right (north) of it
room_orientation.north_wall: short end wall with a pair of connected double-hung windows centered; floating shelves go on either side of them
room_orientation.east_wall: long solid wall for art, with a single doorway at its south end
room_orientation.south_wall: short end wall; the small arched walkway to the foyer is on the west side of it and the walnut credenza and bar is on the east side of it

preserve_from_reference: room dimensions and proportions (approx 21 ft x 14 ft, 8 ft ceiling)
the window and door locations exactly as described in room_orientation; do not add, remove, or move any window or opening
white painted trim, arched walkway to the foyer
light oak hardwood floor with the dark wood inlay border around the hearth
existing two greige sofas (same fabric); the matching loveseat is NOT in this room; no sectional, no new seating
existing walnut mid-century coffee table with lower shelf
existing walnut mid-century credenza used as a bar with record player
existing walnut mid-century arm chair with gray cushion
existing walnut clip-on arm tray tables on the sofa
hard_rule: west wall has the fireplace with one single window south of it and one double window north of it; north wall has one double window; east wall is solid with one doorway at the south end; south wall has the foyer arch on the west side and the credenza on the east side; nothing else; the west wall is one flat plane with no bump-out around the fireplace

replace.fireplace: exactly the fireplace in the fireplace reference photos (images 2 and 3): a shallow white oak box surround, about 5 ft tall and 6 ft wide, mounted against a completely FLAT west wall; the wall is flush on both sides and above, with NO chimney breast, NO bump-out, NO pop-out, NO pilasters or projecting wall section; vertical white oak slats with dark reveals cover the front of the box from the floor to a thick white oak mantel shelf; the slats STOP at the underside of the mantel shelf and the mantel shelf is the top of the entire fireplace; a thin oak frame around handmade ivory ceramic tile (vertical tiles across the top, stacked tiles down the sides) around the firebox; warm white quartz slab hearth with soft gray veining set inside the dark wood inlay border in the floor; the wall above the mantel is plain flat painted wall (Accessible Beige) with no slats, no paneling, and no wood, only the single framed print
replace.bookcases: remove both white bookcases with patterned wallpaper backs on the north wall; replace with two short runs of solid white oak floating shelves, three shelves per side, flanking the north double window, sparsely styled with stacked books, two ceramics, and one trailing plant
replace.rug: remove the small multicolor rug; add a 9 x 12 ivory and oatmeal wool rug, low pile, subtle woven texture, no fringe, no pattern, running the long way from just in front of the hearth border to under the back legs of sofa 1
replace.art: reduce wall art to a few large pieces: one large horizontal muted landscape print in a thin oak frame centered above the mantel on the west wall; three generously spaced pieces on the east wall with a long panoramic line drawing in the center; one vintage cocktail chart centered above the credenza on the south wall
replace.lighting: recessed lights dimmed to a warm low glow; add a brass table lamp on the credenza and a slim brass or black floor lamp behind the sofa; warm 2700K light throughout
replace.textiles: replace small mismatched pillows with four 22 inch pillows in ivory linen and rust velvet plus one olive green, and an oatmeal wool throw draped on sofa 1
replace.windows: add natural woven wood roller shades, inside mount, on the west-wall windows (the single window south of the fireplace and the double window north of it, one shade per sash); the north double window stays bare
replace.plants: one tall olive tree in a matte terracotta pot in the southeast corner of the room, at the east end of the south wall beside the credenza; remove the scattered small floor plants in plastic pots

layout.sofa_1: floated in the middle of the room facing west toward the fireplace, its back toward the east wall with about 3 ft of walking space behind it
layout.sofa_2: at the north end of the seating group facing south, perpendicular to sofa 1 and forming an open L with it, floated a few feet off the north wall
layout.south_end: left open; no furniture between the coffee table and the south wall so the path from the foyer arch to the fireplace and the east doorway is clear
layout.arm_chair_and_pouf: walnut arm chair in the northwest corner under the shelves beside the west double window, angled toward the fireplace, pouf beside it, slim floor lamp next to the chair
layout.north_strip: a low walnut console (about 12 to 14 inches deep, nearly the length of sofa 2) directly behind sofa 2 with a small lamp and one plant on it; a 3 ft walkway between the console and the north wall; a medium plant in the northeast corner; this strip reads as a small reading and library vignette, not leftover space
layout.coffee_table: centered between sofa 1 and hearth with 16 to 18 inches of clearance

palette.woods: white oak on fireplace, shelves, and floor; walnut on all furniture; no other wood tones

style: warm minimal, California mid-century, edited and uncluttered, expensive but not showroom-stiff, lived in
camera: eye level, 24mm full-frame equivalent, natural late-afternoon light from the windows plus warm lamp light, slight haze, realistic shadows
negative: no chimney breast, no bump-out or pop-out wall around the fireplace, no pilasters, no slats or wood above the mantel shelf, no full-height slat wall, no extra furniture, no new wood tones, no gray or beige rug, no curtains, no fringe on the rug, no gallery wall clutter, no brick, no white mantel, no text or watermarks, no people
